subject: School Committee Rules Document
overview: The committee met to review and amend a proposed draft of internal rules governing its operations. Members approved several modifications to meeting schedules, agenda preparation, and public comment procedures before tabling the remainder of the document.

items.title: Rule 9 and 51: Meeting Start Times
items.summary: Approved changing the official meeting start time from 6:00 PM to 6:30 PM and added a reference to the district policy manual.

items.title: Rule 11: Summer Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved replacing the requirement for a formal August meeting with weekly update memos from the Superintendent to the committee.

items.title: Rule 12: Holiday Rescheduling
items.summary: Approved moving meeting dates that fall on non-school holidays to the following Monday rather than the following Wednesday.

items.title: Rule 14: Cancellation Procedures
items.summary: Approved granting the Mayor and Superintendent the discretion to cancel meetings and notify committee members via email.

items.title: Rule 20: Joint Meetings with City Council
items.summary: Modified the rule to require one annual joint meeting with the City Council after a motion to strike the requirement entirely failed.

items.title: Rules 21 and 22: Workshops and Retreats
items.summary: Combined existing draft items to allow for unrecorded workshops and retreats to be scheduled on an as-needed basis.

items.title: Rule 23: Agenda Planning Meetings
items.summary: Approved an amendment allowing the Chair to delegate standing agenda-setting meetings with the Superintendent to the Vice Chair.

items.title: Rules 40 and 43: Agenda Preparation
items.summary: Changed the agenda posting deadline to Thursday at 4:30 PM and substituted the term 'resolutions' for 'motions' in agenda listings.

items.title: Rule 52: Public Comment Registration
items.summary: Removed the requirement for members of the public to register their intent to speak via a form prior to the meeting.

items.title: Rule 67: Rescinding Previous Decisions
items.summary: Tabled the discussion regarding time limits and procedural requirements for rescinding committee actions.
